label: D1 after an unrewarded visit to S2, late in the episode (trial >= ~70)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (0 activations at GO/D2), essentially only when the previous trial was unrewarded (99.4% of mass at prev_reward == 0), and only late in the episode: nothing before trial 40, rate climbing steeply from trial 60 to 99. It also needs the previous trial to have reached S2. When the previous trial reached S1 it is almost silent (scoring prev_state==1 at trial >= 85 gave zero activations). prev_state != 1 is used rather than == 2 because the window first trial has an unknown prev_state, though the agent did see it. That stand-in costs some precision, since about half those unknown cases were really S1. All variables are observed at D1. Dev: (D1 & prev_reward==0 & trial>=70 & prev_state==2) P=0.67 R=0.77. The recorded version: P=0.58 R=0.91 mass recall 0.97. Without the S2 condition, P=0.36. The remaining false positives are mostly unrewarded S2 D1 steps that sit right at the onset threshold, or follow several unrewarded trials in a row. The top activations are the first unrewarded S2 outcome after a run of rewarded trials, often while S1 is the good state. That fits the model value being low (all mass at value < 7.5). The magnitude ordering is from example windows only and was not checked quantitatively. The episode-time gating suggests it is partly a clock or late-episode signal.
